text:
name: Engineering baseline
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  baseline:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:14.20
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: tileset
          POSTGRES_DB: tileset_ci
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 127.0.0.1:55432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U tileset -d tileset_ci"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://tileset@127.0.0.1:55432/tileset_ci
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        # The step07 regression reads the published step06 writer with git show.
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@f40ffcd9367d9f12939873eb1018b921a783ffaa
        with:
          version: 10.20.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: 22.21.1
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm db:generate
      - run: pnpm check
      - run: pnpm test:dev-privacy
      - run: pnpm db:migrate
      - run: pnpm test:integration
      - run: TILESET_PG_BIN=/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin pnpm test:step06
      - run: TILESET_PG_BIN=/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin pnpm test:step07
      - run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: pnpm test:e2e
      - run: E2E_MODE=dev pnpm test:e2e
